_comment: Action dispatch for cd82-fb555c5d, read from source on 15-Sep-2026. Line numbers are anchors checked by scripts/test_dispatch_tables.py.

dispatch.form: if/elif chain on a local `action` bound at :620

guards.meaning: the action budget is exhausted: the run is lost and nothing is dispatched.
a commit animation is running: it is advanced and the submitted action is discarded.
a second animation state is running: same, the action is discarded.

available_actions.note: Declared list agrees with every row of 496ee425-9705-409f-8410-463a2229627e. The runtime filter narrows it hard, see runtime_filter.

runtime_filter.meaning: Cd82._get_valid_actions is state-dependent: when the commit flag is set it offers ONLY ACTION5 (:736-738); below three placements it offers ACTION1-4 plus one set of click targets; at three or more it adds a second set; at six or more it offers only click targets. So the offered set changes shape three times within a level.

ACTION1.effect: Moves the selection cursor one step up on a 3x3 pad, clamped to 0 at :513. The centre cell is skipped: nqhfiooufi returns without effect if the destination is (1, 1) (:522). So this action is a no-op on two of the eight legal positions.

branch_conditions.meaning: destination is the centre of the pad: return, no move.

branch_conditions.text: if jfwczrxztz is not None and jfwczrxztz != self.xwmfgtlso:
branch_conditions.meaning: the move only takes effect when the destination maps to a target different from the current one; otherwise the cursor does not move.

ACTION2.effect: Moves the selection cursor one step down, clamped to 2 at :515. Same centre-skip and no-target guards.

ACTION3.effect: Moves the selection cursor one step left, clamped to 0 at :517. Same guards.

ACTION4.effect: Moves the selection cursor one step right, clamped to 2 at :519. Same guards.

ACTION5.effect: Commits the current selection. nlvliaznao at :651 sets the animation flag at :655, which makes the guard at :614 take over on every following step until the animation drains. It also zeroes the placement counter at :639, which resets the shape of _get_valid_actions.
ACTION5.note: ACTION5 does not complete_action() on its own line; the commit animation does.

ACTION6.effect: Acts on the clicked cell. The call is guarded at :643 - an ACTION6 submitted without both x and y in data falls through to the bare complete_action() at :647/:649 and changes nothing.

branch_conditions.text: if "x" in data and "y" in data:
branch_conditions.meaning: both x and y must be present in action.data or the click is discarded.
if the click started an animation, completion is deferred to it.

unhandled_actions.note: ACTION7 and RESET have no branch in Cd82.step and ACTION7 is not offered. RESET is handled by arcengine, which is not vendored.

sibling_builds.reason: cd82-fb555c5d is the only cd82 build in either replay manifest and the only cd82 directory under docs/static/games/src/. The question does not arise. See dispatch/README.md for the cross-game measurement that settles it in general.

notes: Two animation guards (:614, :617) discard the submitted action. As in g50t, a row that changed nothing may have arrived mid-animation rather than having been a wrong move.
The available-action set changes shape three times within a level; a record's memory_in should not assume a fixed action set.
